summary: The value from request.getParameter("CWE690") can be null and is stored in the HashMap, then dereferenced via data.equals(...) in badSink, causing a NULL pointer dereference (CWE-690). Guard the dereference with a null check so legitimate non-null values still match, while null input no longer throws.
